answer: Have standing decay on a fixed clock, refreshed only by fresh verifiable work each window. A farmer who tries to forge N sock puppets must supply N parallel streams of real output every cycle or watch those scores erode back to zero - carrying cost scales with fleet size and idle shells rot untouched. A reputation mesa raised overnight washes away in the next rain, while a peer's pearl of standing takes months of unbroken work to accrete. Decay turns sybil resistance from a one-time entry fee into a permanent per-head rent.
